name: IPv4 header, checksum field zero
ref: Wikipedia, IPv4 header checksum worked example

example.title: The checksum of an IPv4 header with a zero field
example.note: The header has zeros in its checksum field. The result b861 is the value to write into that field.

name: IPv4 header with its checksum verifies to zero
ref: Wikipedia, IPv4 header checksum worked example

example.title: A header with its checksum verifies to zero
example.note: With b861 in the field, the same header sums to 0000, which is how a receiver checks it.

name: empty input
ref: RFC 1071: an empty sum is zero, complement ffff

name: odd length pads a zero byte on the right
carry folded twice
ref: hand-computed: every ffff word is zero in ones complement, so the sum folds to ffff and its complement is 0000
